decisions.decision: The applicant's engineer verbally withdrew the Traffic Impact Report, Environmental Impact Report and Community Impact Report from the listed waivers (Sections 4.1.f(22), 4.1.f(23), 4.1.h).
decisions.quote: as a traffic impact report, environmental impact report, and community impact report were submitted this evening, ddcdg verbally withdrew those three from the waivers listed above.

decisions.decision: The applicant will pave the first twenty/twenty-five feet of the Massachusetts Avenue entrance and blend it into the gravel shoulder.
decisions.quote: it was determined that ddcg will pave the first twenty/twenty-five feet (20-25') of the entrance and then blend it into the gravel shoulder.

decisions.decision: No signage will be erected for No Parking near the Massachusetts Avenue end; the Board will condition no parking, enforceable through future signage or pavement painting if necessary.
decisions.quote: signage will not be erected for no parking near the massachusetts avenue end, but the board will condition no parking with the stipulation that it can be enforced

decisions.decision: By consensus, the decision will condition that all outstanding comments of the reviewing engineer be addressed to the reviewing engineer's satisfaction.
decisions.quote: board consensus was to condition that all outstanding comments of the reviewing engineer were addressed to his (reviewing engineer) satisfaction.
